verdict.rationale: Cognee's docs explicitly describe building a knowledge graph of entities and relationships from ingested data (.remember, ontology support for canonical entity types) and retrieving via .recall with auto-routed strategies, which is designed for multi-hop/entity-centric queries; .improve further enriches the graph over time. Community commentary raises architectural skepticism about heavy KG design being overkill, but this is opinion/tradeoff discussion, not a concrete hands-on failure of graph-based multi-hop retrieval, so it doesn't rise to 'disputed'. Missing for 10: independent benchmark or hands-on validation of actual multi-hop/entity-centric query accuracy beyond vendor docs.
